text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm landing a small docs PR that adds a dedicated 'Bootcamp' quickstart for provisioned capacity. Want to flag a couple spots for POV wording on autoscale defaults.
jon: SGTM. Link the draft?
maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (WIP) — major bits: onboarding checklist, sample terraform snippet, SDK example for tenant labels, and a note about SLA tiers.
sam: glanced — nice. Two quick things: 1) autoscale cooldown default is still '60s' in the example, but our runtime defaults to 30s now. Should align. 2) isolation wording calls out 'preemption' — can we clarify that preemption only applies to burst pools?
kevin: For SDK example can we use the new python client pattern? e.g.,
```
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient()
client.provision(reservation="standard", tenant_id="acme-123", labels={"env":"prod"})
```
Use that vs raw REST snippet.
maria: Good catches. I'll update cooldown to 30s and reword preemption to "burst-only preemption" with a link to the capacity model page. Also swap SDK snippet to the python pattern.
jon: Also add a tiny migration note for teams on v0.9 -> v1.0 of our provisioning schema. People keep hitting the tenant label rename. Example YAML diff like: 
```
# old
tenant:
  id: acme
  labels: {team: "search"}
# new
tenant_id: acme
labels:
  team: search
```
That saved me time in an onboarding call yesterday.
sam: One more nit — SLA wording: current draft says "99.9% latency SLA" which is ambiguous. Suggest changing to "99.9% uptime with P50 latency < 200ms for standard reservations" or split uptime vs latency.
maria: Agree. I'll propose a two-row SLA table (uptime | latency) and add a footnote about regional failover and isolation impacts. Can someone sanity-check the numbers?
kevin: From infra side, 99.9% uptime is fine for standard reserved pools but P50 200ms only applies in-region. Add a sentence: "Latency targets are regional and computed per-reservation under steady-state load."
docs-bot: Reminder: link-checker job queued for PR 482 — will run after CI.
maria: Thanks all. Action items: I'll push updates tonight: 1) change cooldown to 30s 2) swap SDK snippet to DedicatedClient python 3) add migration YAML snippet and callout 4) replace SLA phrasing with 2-row table + footnote 5) clarify preemption = burst-only and add link.
jon: If you want me to review after you push, ping me and I'll take a look.
sam: I'll double-check the terraform snippet for required IAM roles once the PR is updated.
kevin: FYI: if we reference terraform, prefer the minimal example that uses our module: `module "dedicated" { source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/terraform-modules.git//dedicated" }` — then people have fewer moving parts.
maria: Great — I'll incorporate and mark the PR as ready for review once updated. ETA: tomorrow morning PT.
jon: Thanks — this will make onboarding much smoother.
maria: Thanks everyone! :rocket:
